correctness.rationale: The stated six-state Markov generator is the finite-duration tumble generator in the primary source. Its invariant vector and the sign-involution symmetry have been independently checked. Exact clipped harmonic flows bound X by v/mu, yield the no-switch negative hitting time, and identify a one-sided sign-memory mismatch. The stationary +1->0->-1 crossing flux is exact. Conditioning on a rare jump out of -1 adds a zero-state hold factor 1+beta/(4alpha)+alpha/(2beta); all later corrections have a uniform smaller order by exponential contraction. The limiting integral gives pi^2/12 and the coefficient follows without assuming a full stationary density. The delivered verification program passed 502 checks, which do not substitute for analytic limiting arguments.

value.rationale: Exact contact probability (a Dirac boundary mass) is a physically natural jamming observable. Weak convergence of distances to zero is blind to whether particles are genuinely jammed; the theorem finds the universal one-half atom and a sharp, strictly positive two-switch correction with a dilogarithmic coefficient and an identifiable holding-time memory factor. It quantitatively addresses the finite-harmonic finite-tumble case marked difficult in the 2025 source without needing a full invariant density.
